summary: Number.isNaN reports whether an already evaluated value is the numeric NaN value.
documentation: Number.isNaN reports whether an already evaluated value is the numeric NaN value. It does not coerce strings. A separate Number conversion lets you distinguish failed numeric conversions from valid zero values.
inputs: An array of strings to convert with Number.
returns: A Boolean for each string: true when conversion produces NaN.
caution: Empty and whitespace-only strings convert to zero. Infinity is not NaN, so this is not a complete finite-number validator.
scenarios: Flag nonnumeric CSV cells before aggregation.
Distinguish a failed calculator conversion from a valid zero.
Explain numeric conversion errors in a form preview.
title: Find failed numeric conversions
problem: Convert each input string with Number and return a Boolean array indicating which results are NaN. Preserve order. Do not treat Infinity or whitespace as failed conversions.
goal: Use Number.isNaN() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Convert first, then apply Number.isNaN to the result.
